children: Romania's central bank unanimously voted to keep interest rates (ROINTR=ECI) on hold at 6.50% on Oct. 8, central bank minutes showed on Tuesday, maintaining policy status-quo as it seeks to balance out upward pressure on inflation while the economy contracts.

The central bank, which targets inflation at 1.5%-3.5%, said annual inflation will run above its current 6.1% forecast for end-2026, driven by currency weakness and supply side shocks from higher global fuels and energy prices.
